Phoenix Suns — injuries
Goodwin (calf) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Spurs, Kellan Olson of ArizonaSports.com reports.
Goodwin will miss a fourth consecutive contest due to a right calf injury, with his next chance to return coming Tuesday against the Clippers. Luke Kennard and Ryan Dunn are candidates for increased playing time in Goodwin's stead.
